Interface ExecutionStats

public interface ExecutionStats
A snapshot of a RequestExecutionEngine run's progress: how many requests have been requested, completed and failed, how many are in flight or pending, and how long the run has been going. The same shape is reported live during a run (via RequestExecution.stats()) and for the terminated run (via RequestExecutionResult.stats()).
